name: image-gallery
purpose: The images of one response: a responsive grid of thumbnails that opens one image larger in a `Dialog`, with previous, next and Download. It takes each image as a URL or as base64 data with its media type, so a chat can show the images a model returned in a message or a generation finished with. While images are generating it holds one `Skeleton` per expected image, and when the request fails it shows the error in place of the grid. It draws what the app hands it; it generates and fetches nothing.
useWhen: The images in an assistant message: one or several image parts, from a URL or base64 data.
The result of an image generation request: several images, a generating state and a failed state.
Any set of a few related images a person wants to look at one by one and download.
avoidWhen: One stored file with its name, size and type, in a file browser — use `FilePreview`.
A row of marketing cards or images that scrolls sideways — use `Carousel`.
A picture you already have at a known size inside text or a card — a plain `img` is enough.
Files attached to a prompt before it is sent — use `FileTokenGroup`.
related: `Dialog` — the viewer that opens one image larger.
`Skeleton` — the placeholder per expected image while images generate.
`EmptyState` — the error state, the empty state and an image that fails to load in the viewer.
`FilePreview` — one stored file with a type-aware body.
`ChatMessage` — the message an image gallery sits in.
bestPractices: Pass `alt` from what the image shows (a model's revised prompt is a good source); an image with no `alt` is named by its position ("Image 2 of 4").
Give every item a stable `key` (the message id and the part index) so the grid keeps each image when items arrive one by one.
Set `expectedCount` to the number of images requested, so the placeholders match the result.
Base64 data stays in memory as a data URL; for large images prefer a URL the app serves.
Handle `download` and call `event.preventDefault()` when the image is on another origin or needs a signed URL; a same-origin, `blob:` or `data:` image downloads by itself.

props.name: items
props.doc: Images to show, each from a URL (`src`) or base64 `data` with its `mimeType`.

props.name: loading
props.doc: Images are still generating: placeholders fill the grid after the images already in `items`, up to `expectedCount`.

props.name: expectedCount
props.doc: Number of images expected while `loading`; the grid shows a placeholder for each one not in `items` yet.

props.name: error
props.doc: Why the images could not load or generate. Set, the gallery shows the error state in place of the grid, with this text under its title.

events.name: download
events.notes: Download in the viewer was pressed for `item`. Download is a link with the `download` attribute, so the browser saves a same-origin, `blob:` or `data:` image unless the handler calls `preventDefault()`; browsers ignore `download` on a cross-origin URL and open it instead, so an app with cross-origin images handles this event (`preventDefault()` and its own download).

events.name: retry
events.notes: Try again in the error state was pressed. The button renders only when this event has a listener, so a gallery whose app cannot run the request again shows no dead button; the app starts the request again and clears `error`.
